soldier: Major soldier: head and thoracic dorsum yellowish brown, the abdominal dorsum slightly paler. Head capsule almost trapezoidal, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin straight; fontanelle dot-like, situated in front of the midpoint of the head, in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head highly arched at the fontanelle, the frontal region flat and slightly concave, the ventral margin of the head and the posterior part of the postmentum markedly projecting. Labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip triangular; mandibles stout, the anterior part rather curved, the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible with traces of fine teeth, several incisions in front of the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 rather long, segments 2 and 4 nearly equal, segment 5 shorter; postmentum 3.78 times as long as the waist width. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a shallow incision in the middle, the posterior margin and the posterior margin of the mesonotum shallowly concave in the middle, the posterior margin of the metanotum straight in the middle; the lateral margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum angular, the metanotum slightly obtuse. Minor soldier: head and thoracic dorsum bright yellow tinged with brown, the abdominal dorsum pale yellow; head capsule intermediate between oval and trapezoidal, widest behind the middle; postmentum band-like, 2.45 to 2.77 times as long as wide; anterior margin of the pronotum broadly rounded.
